boundaryExclusions.reason: SEND timestamp outside predefined [start,end); original row retained

definitions.cohort: Measurement SEND timestamp in [start,end), unchanged original raw
definitions.quantiles: Nearest-rank per run; group median/min/max across three separate run summaries
definitions.ranges: Observed min-max of three runs, not confidence intervals
definitions.pooledECDF: Pooled cohort requests across three runs, descriptive only, separate from median-of-run metrics
definitions.cpu: Percent of one logical core, weighted by sampled elapsed time; can exceed 100
definitions.serverResources: Whole observed JVM lifecycle including startup/JIT/warmup; not isolated 60s steady state
definitions.nodeResources: Only sample timestamps inside measurement window; first-last spans recorded explicitly
definitions.eventLoopDelay: Node monitorEventLoopDelay at 20ms resolution, all phases including connect/warmup
definitions.cpuPostgres: Not sampled as a separate process
